meta.title: H3 Image (local MLX)
meta.description: Fully local text-to-image on Apple Silicon using the open-source MiniMax H3-Image model on MLX. A one-time setup downloads the pinned engine and weights to your machine (the MiniMax community license, including its region terms, is shown before any download and you accept it yourself); generation then runs offline — no keys, no accounts, no cloud calls. Requires Apple Silicon with 48 GB+ unified memory (32 GB is not guaranteed); Intel Macs and other platforms are declined up front. This build (0.1.0) ships the read-only environment check and local generation (license acceptance is yours to record explicitly); the one-click setup wizard arrives in the next milestone.
